description: N-terminal targeting-signal features of ASCT and ACD candidates against organelle-localised positive controls and cytosolic negative controls
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, math, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

SET = {
 # experimentally organelle-localised in Blastocystis / canonical MRO matrix proteins (positive controls)
 "B3FHT4":      ("SCS alpha (organelle-localised, PMID 18452512)","positive control"),
 "A0A196S3L2":  ("[FeFe] hydrogenase","positive control"),
 "A0A196SEK7":  ("SDH flavoprotein subunit","positive control"),
 "A0A196S6I0":  ("PNO (pyruvate dehydrogenase NADP+)","positive control"),
 "A0A196S9Q0":  ("Complex I flavoprotein NDUFV1","positive control"),
 "A0A196SCN8":  ("SCS beta","positive control"),
 "A0A196SBG0":  ("malate dehydrogenase (OAA-forming)","positive control"),
 # the proteins whose location decides the pathway question
 "A0A196SMF3":  ("ASCT candidate ACH1 (OAO17397.1)","test"),
 "A0A196SNA7":  ("ASCT candidate ACH2 (OAO17721.1)","test"),
 "A0A196SMQ0":  ("ADP-forming acetyl-CoA synthetase 1","test"),
 "A0A196S6S6":  ("ADP-forming acetyl-CoA synthetase 2","test"),
 "A0A196S9Z5":  ("ADP-forming acetyl-CoA synthetase 3","test"),
 "A0A196SIB1":  ("methylmalonyl-CoA mutase","test"),
 "A0A0K0MD83":  ("RquA (rhodoquinone biosynthesis)","test"),
 # cytosolic negative controls
 "A0A196SGI2":  ("pyruvate kinase","negative control"),
 "A0A196SGU2":  ("phosphoglycerate kinase","negative control"),
 "A0A196SCA0":  ("triosephosphate isomerase","negative control"),
 # cross-species reference positive controls (proven presequence-bearing MRO proteins)
 "Q27089":      ("T. vaginalis ferredoxin (cleaved 8-aa presequence)","reference positive"),
}
seqs={}
for a in SET:
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text
    seqs[a]="".join(t.split("\n")[1:]).strip()

# Eisenberg consensus hydrophobicity
EIS=dict(A=0.62,R=-2.53,N=-0.78,D=-0.90,C=0.29,Q=-0.85,E=-0.74,G=0.48,H=-0.40,I=1.38,
         L=1.06,K=-1.50,M=0.64,F=1.19,P=0.12,S=-0.18,T=-0.05,W=0.81,Y=0.26,V=1.08)
def hmoment(seq, delta=100.0):
    ang=np.deg2rad(delta)*np.arange(len(seq))
    h=np.array([EIS.get(c,0.0) for c in seq])
    return math.hypot((h*np.cos(ang)).sum(), (h*np.sin(ang)).sum())/len(seq)

def features(s, N=30, win=18):
    nt=s[:N]
    pos=sum(nt.count(c) for c in "RK"); neg=sum(nt.count(c) for c in "DE")
    best=max((hmoment(nt[i:i+win]) for i in range(0,max(1,len(nt)-win+1))), default=0.0)
    return dict(len_seq=len(s), R=nt.count("R"), K=nt.count("K"), D=nt.count("D"), E=nt.count("E"),
                S=nt.count("S"), L=nt.count("L"), A=nt.count("A"),
                net_charge_1_30=pos-neg, acidic_1_30=neg,
                max_hydrophobic_moment=round(best,3), nterm=nt)

rows=[]
for a,(name,grp) in SET.items():
    f=features(seqs[a]); f.update(acc=a, protein=name, group=grp); rows.append(f)
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)[["acc","protein","group","len_seq","net_charge_1_30","acidic_1_30","R","S","max_hydrophobic_moment","nterm"]]
df=df.sort_values(["group","net_charge_1_30"],ascending=[True,False])
pd.set_option("display.width",260); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",46)
print(df.to_string(index=False))
df.to_csv("nterminal_targeting_features.csv",index=False)

# group comparison
print("\nGroup medians:")
print(df.groupby("group")[["net_charge_1_30","acidic_1_30","max_hydrophobic_moment"]].median().to_string())

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5))
colors={"positive control":"#2a7fbf","test":"#d1495b","negative control":"#6c757d","reference positive":"#1b998b"}
ax=axes[0]
for g,sub in df.groupby("group"):
    ax.scatter(sub.net_charge_1_30, sub.max_hydrophobic_moment, s=90, label=g, color=colors[g],
               edgecolor="k", linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)
for _,r in df.iterrows():
    if r.group in ("test","positive control"):
        ax.annotate(r.protein.split(" (")[0][:26], (r.net_charge_1_30, r.max_hydrophobic_moment),
                    fontsize=7, xytext=(4,4), textcoords="offset points")
ax.axvline(2.5, color="grey", ls="--", lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel("net charge of residues 1-30 (R+K minus D+E)")
ax.set_ylabel("max hydrophobic moment, 18-residue window")
ax.set_title("N-terminal presequence features in the ST1 NandII proteome")
ax.legend(fontsize=8, frameon=False)

ax=axes[1]
order=["negative control","test","positive control","reference positive"]
dat=[df.loc[df.group==g,"net_charge_1_30"].values for g in order]
bp=ax.boxplot(dat, labels=[o.replace(" ","\n") for o in order], widths=0.55, patch_artist=True)
for p,g in zip(bp["boxes"],order): p.set_facecolor(colors[g]); p.set_alpha(0.55)
for i,(g,v) in enumerate(zip(order,dat)):
    ax.scatter(np.full(len(v), i+1)+np.linspace(-0.12,0.12,len(v)), v, color="k", s=22, zorder=3)
ax.set_ylabel("net charge of residues 1-30")
ax.set_title("Positive charge of the first 30 residues")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
